source: Computed from the released data for Studies 3, 4 and 5 (analysis/study3-full-results.py, study4-full-results.py, study5-full-results.py) and Study 1 as before. Trust in Studies 1, 3 and 4; combined trust and belief in Study 5.
measure: Cohen's d for how much more people trusted the doctor, or the humanlike AI, than the standard AI
note: d is shown as a positive number when the doctor, or the humanlike AI, was trusted more than the standard AI. Between-person comparisons use Cohen's d with the pooled standard deviation; same-person comparisons use dz, the mean difference over the SD of the differences. Filled dot: p < .05. Hollow dot: not significant. Study 1 has no humanlike AI condition. These values differ slightly from the dissertation text, which computed d as 2t over the square root of the degrees of freedom.
